text:
If you’ve got Labor Day off, this is the one to spend outside: bright sunshine, low humidity, and a high right around 79. The lake stays unusually quiet, with northwest winds building toward 10 knots, waves a foot or less, and 66-degree water. Clouds fill in tonight, with only a slight chance of a shower after 2am and a low near 58.

Tuesday looks cooler, partly sunny, and mostly dry, with a high around 74. A few forecast models are wetter on Tuesday morning than the official call, so I’d keep a light rain jacket handy, but I wouldn’t cancel plans. More widespread rain looks like a Wednesday night into Thursday problem, followed by a drier stretch late in the week. Take the long bike ride, waterfront walk, or paddle today, and be ready for a cooler, cloudier start tomorrow.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Labor Day! If you are lucky enough to have today off, it looks to be the nicest day of the long weekend. Our day features mainly sunny skies overhead, with afternoon highs that are a bit warmer than Saturday and Sunday as most head back into the low and mid-70s this afternoon. Tonight, clouds start to fill back ahead of a few early morning rain showers as lows fall back into the mid and upper 50s.
